newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Bank shares strengthen on buy-backs.
newsitem.headline: Japan Bank shares strengthen on buy-backs.

text.p: Bank sector shares rose in Friday afternoon trade as buy-backs supported by the government's intention to improve land liquidity lifted the sector, brokers said.
As of 0439 GMT, the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd was up 10 yen at 1,370, the third most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo boures with trade totalling 5.03 million shares.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd, up 30 yen at 2,100, was the next largest with volume of 4.963 million shares traded.
